tagline: Tracing, monitoring, cost tracking and debugging for AI agents and LLM apps in production.
scope: It is about watching agents or LLM apps run in production, not offline benchmarks or general logging with no LLM story.
heroAlt: Animated isometric scene: a playhead sweeps a trace board as agent spans grow into a waterfall, a magnifying lens follows the newest span and settles on the one that fails red, and telemetry rides a wire to a monitor whose graph ticks.
